title: What if the wind never stopped? (20 to 1,000 km/h)
description:
What would happen if the wind never stopped, and kept getting stronger every hour? 🌪️

From a light breeze to 1,000 km/h: what would break first, and what would be left standing at the end?

Which wind speed would your house survive? 👇
